en.answer:
If <<11679>> itself has been destroyed at the time of the resolution of its Pendulum Effect, the effect is not applied.

(Neither part of the effect is applied)
en.question: If <<4909>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the Pendulum Effect of <<11679>> that destroys it and draws 1 card, destroying <<11679>> , what happens with the part of the effect that draws cards?

ja.answer:
「<<11679>>」のペンデュラム効果の処理時に、「<<11679>>」自身が破壊されている場合には効果処理は適用されません。
（「<<11679>>」自身を破壊する処理も、デッキから１枚ドローする処理も適用されません。）
